target.title: fix(telegram): add request timeout to media file downloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Telegram media downloads already had a body read idle timeout, but the Bot API file download call did not pass an overall request timeout to `saveRemoteMedia`. A stalled Telegram file endpoint or custom Bot API host could hang before the response/body path that the idle timeout protects.

## Why This Change Was Made
The shared media runtime already supports `timeoutMs` in addition to `readIdleTimeoutMs`. This PR wires a 120s request timeout into the Telegram media file download call while preserving the existing retry policy, explicit proxy fallback, SSRF policy, and 30s body idle timeout.

## User Impact
Telegram inbound media downloads now have both connection/request and body-idle protection instead of only body-idle protection.

## Evidence
- Focused test: `pnpm vitest run extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media-retry.test.ts` -> 42 passed.
- Format/lint: `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media-retry.test.ts && pnpm exec oxlint extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media-retry.test.ts` -> passed.
- Whitespace: `git diff --check` -> clean.
- Collision check before opening: open PR changed-files query for `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media.ts` and `extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.resolve-media-retry.test.ts` returned no open PRs.

## Proof
Real behavior addressed: Telegram file downloads now pass `timeoutMs` into the existing media runtime path that aborts stalled guarded fetch requests. The existing `readIdleTimeoutMs` remains in place for body stalls after the response begins.

Focused regression: the explicit-proxy media download test now asserts the call includes both `timeoutMs: 120_000` and `readIdleTimeoutMs: 30_000`, preserving the proxy fallback and retry behavior while adding request-level timeout coverage.

What was not tested: live Telegram Bot API traffic. The focused test verifies the exact media runtime call contract used by the production download path.
